documents.title: Span guide
documents.text:
# Span<T>
Span<T> is a ref struct that provides a type-safe view over contiguous memory without copying.

## Slicing
Slice returns a new Span over part of the same memory, so no allocation happens.

documents.title: Async guide
documents.text:
# Async and await
A Task represents an asynchronous operation. Use await to resume after the task completes without blocking the thread.

## Async void
Avoid async void except for event handlers because exceptions cannot be observed by the caller.

documents.title: LINQ guide
documents.text:
# LINQ
LINQ queries are lazily evaluated. Calling ToList forces immediate execution and materializes the results.

## Deferred execution
A query defined with Where does not run until it is enumerated.

documents.title: Disposal guide
documents.text:
# IDisposable
Implement IDisposable to release unmanaged resources deterministically. The using statement calls Dispose even when an exception is thrown.
